description: Find Taiwan stocks and ETFs listed on TWSE or TPEx (still trading) by code, Chinese short or full name, or English name; start here to get the `code` every other tw_ tool takes (TSMC is 2330). Matching runs in tiers: exact code, code prefix, exact short name, short name prefix, short name contains, then full name or English names contain (queries of at least 2 characters); within a tier companies come before ETFs and other securities, then larger market caps first. 2330.TW and 2330.TWO are read as the code. Each result has code, name and full_name (Traditional Chinese), name_en, market (TWSE or TPEx), kind (stock, etf, other) and url. Follow up with tw_get_stock. Taiwan stocks are separate from the US tools (search, get_stock); TSMC's US ADR is TSM there. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

query.description: A code (2330, 2330.TW), a Chinese short or full company name, or an English name (TSMC, Taiwan Semiconductor).

name: tw_search

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

query.description: The query as searched (spaces collapsed; a .TW or .TWO suffix removed).

code.description: The code the other tw_ tools take.

kind.description: stock = a company (including TDRs); etf; other = preferred shares, ETNs, REITs and similar.

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

name_en.description: English short name; null when there is none.

title: Search Taiwan stocks
